dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger.; City limits for 1873, 1878, and 1883 are marked in color-coded ink on an unidentified base map. An additional, later city boundary is also shown but is not included in the color key. Base map appears to be the left half of a map of the Twin Cities metropolitan area.; Electrical power lines (undated) are indicated in red.; Map shows railroads, water works, municipal buildings, cemeteries, and green spaces,; Slight registration error in printed shading of green spaces.; Watermark: "Crane & Co. Dalton Mass. 1893 No. 18".; Stamped on recto at lower left corner: "Drawing no. 199, City Engineer's Office. Vault no. 1, case no. 1, drawer no. D7."; Marked on verso: "Cannot film legend in color."; Marked on verso: "T6-1".
